audit: mod.rs barrel declarations missing pub mod
method: for every mod.rs, compare declared `mod X;` against sibling .rs files and subdirs with mod.rs

true_positive.problem: never declared `pub mod builtin|bundled_modules|loader|runner|types|wrapper`, so the whole extension tree was unreachable while the files existed on disk (883 B barrel, 6 real modules)
true_positive.fix: lead added the six declarations, matching the TS index.ts re-export list and the pattern used by core/kernel/mod.rs

false_positives_note: the 4 crate-root mod.rs files (pi-ai, pi-agent-core, pi-tui, pi-coding-agent) are reached through lib.rs, which declares the modules; pi-ai uses #[path="mod.rs"] pub mod index;. Not defects.
lesson: the compiler is the verdict; sibling-file heuristics produce false positives
